To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) 5% of the Hi-C data are sufficient for reproducing most of the previous findings in the 3D genome field, 2) 3D models can be improved by introducing additional physical interactions, and 3) the additional interactions can be based on orthologs or predicted functional interactions.

(i) 3D recon-struction methods based on Hi-C contact data are able to reproduce the results obtained from previous analyses of the 3d genome of the eukayote Saccharomyce cerevisiae, (ii) the results of the previous analyses can be reproduced using a small fraction of experimental data, and (iii) 3D reconstruction models can be improved using additional information, such as orthologous interactions or predicted functional interactions.
